description:
How Chroma Sync Works
Sync runs the same pipeline regardless of source:
- Managed ingestion. Connect a source once; every invocation runs through Chroma’s queue-based pipeline with automatic retries, rate-limit awareness, and error recovery. Monitor invocations in the dashboard or through the Sync API.
- High throughput. The pipeline is designed to maximize throughput without dropping work, whether you’re syncing a handful of files or millions of documents.
